	COLDWAR_POL_service_the_debt = {
		icon = generic_fundraising
		allowed = { original_tag = POL }

		cost = 0
		days_re_enable = 60

		visible = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_initialized }
		available = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_POL_debt > 0 } }

		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Decision COLDWAR_POL_service_the_debt"
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.01 } }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_POL_debt_m5_tt
			hidden_effect = { set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_POL_debt_change = -5 } COLDWAR_POL_change_debt = yes }
		}

		ai_will_do = {
			base = 1
			modifier = { factor = 5 check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_POL_debt value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_active_mission = bankruptcy_incoming_collapse }
		}
	}
}
